correctness.rationale: Read and checked the exact spectral premises in Golla–Osaka–Sequeira Theorem 2.2 and Corollary 2.17: complete orthogonal pure-point eigenbasis with no infinite strictly increasing distinct eigenvalues characterizes the norm-attaining-every-reducing-subspace positive class, and no infinite strictly decreasing sequence characterizes the minimum-attaining class. A nondecreasing scalar map preserves both sequence exclusions; nonincreasing swaps them. Strict monotonicity has a continuous inverse on f([0,R]), so functional calculus reflects each class. Necessity: every violation of oriented monotonicity yields strictly monotone bounded diagonal eigenvalue sequences with unattained extremal f-level by a continuity crossing construction; flat nondegenerate intervals yield f(A) scalar while A fails reflection. Counterexamples live on l2, never finite truncations. No external computation or mere samples are taken as proof.
